scope: All 38 pending visual blocks on 12 slides reviewed against PowerPoint read-only renders and native shape positions; proposed decisions only, no product review saved

decisionGroups.reason: Large illustrative scenes add no distinct factual claim; the adjacent editable text carries the stated project content. Do not treat depicted satellites, launches or laboratories as observed project evidence.
Feature and expected-outcome icons repeat nearby editable headings and descriptions; they add no independent measurements or component labels.
Four chevrons repeat the explicit native 1–4 sequence and adjacent Sensors, Microcontroller, LoRa Radio, Ground Station labels.

decisionGroups.reviewText: Three left-to-right arrows connect Sensors GPS/BMP180 to Microcontroller ESP32/Arduino, then LoRa Radio SX127x, then Ground Station.
decisionGroups.reason: Direction and adjacency are needed for the architecture question; native labels alone do not encode the connections.
Four lines draw the Operator stick figure. The second line to Start Mission duplicates the first association line; these add no separate use case.

decisionGroups.reviewText: The Operator has links to Start Mission, Receive Telemetry, Monitor GPS/Altitude, Store Data and Analyze Mission. This is a proposed use-case diagram, not proof that these functions were implemented.
decisionGroups.reason: The five distinct associations are conveyed by source lines rather than by the use-case labels alone.

decisionGroups.reviewText: Downward arrows order Read Sensors → Build Packet + CRC → Transmit LoRa Frame → Decode + Deliver Payload → Display + Store (CSV/DB).
decisionGroups.reason: The arrows establish direction of the five telemetry steps for the cross-slide draft question.
